decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is close to the core postpress offer and fits established sales and service routines, and with no performance shortfall evident there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core and its results are still uncertain, but it is a flagship with a German premiere, and the slack from industry growth lets the firm carry it longer.
The sheet preparation module complements the modular systems at low carrying cost, so it supports complete-line sales and gives no reason for withdrawal.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship close to the core and central to the automation direction, so it very likely meets aspirations.
The folding add-on unit has a documented customer installation with the Touchline line, so its results are in line with aspirations and it supports sales of integrated systems.
